ns2:section.sectionText: Section L1 and L2: Chemistry and Biology of Everyday Life Intended for students from freshman to senior science majors wishing to explore in depth scientific topics of their interests within the chemistry and biology of everyday phenomena. Initial activities will involve learning and giving presentations about the topics of interests. Later activities could involve performing research in a laboratory. Students will interact closely with professors and other researchers to design and carry out their project. This course is offered to students of all levels. Students who enroll in the course for the first time should sign up for LEC L1 (2 credit hours). Return students should sign up for LEC L2 (1credit hour). Repeating the course for credit is highly encouraged. Please check the web site at hhttp://atlas.scs.uiuc.edu/chem199L for a detailed description of the course content and registration information.
